title: Cross-tenant metric normalizer and synthetic-token playback for reproducible observability
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation:
We observe noisy tenant-level signals and brittle dashboard comparisons during rollouts of runtime changes. Alert thresholds tuned to absolute token-cost or latency buckets don't translate across tenants with different invocation shapes. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a lightweight cross-tenant metric normalizer service that produces stable, per-tenant normalization scores (z-like and rank-based percentiles) for core token/latency/cost metrics; (2) a synthetic-token playback generator that replays deterministic token-shaped invocations to validate dashboards and simulate alerts under controlled conditions.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds observability/metric-normalizer: a service that consumes routed metrics, maintains sliding-window summaries, and emits normalized time series (tenant_norm_{metric}) plus normalization metadata (sample_count, shard_version).
- Adds synth_playback CLI and library to generate deterministic token traces from recorded prompt shapes and replay them into the ingest pipeline for dashboard replay and alert simulation.
- Wires the normalizer into the metric ingest proxy so dashboards and alerts can opt into normalized series without changing collectors.
- Adds a set of Grafana dashboards and a simulation page (dashboards/normalized-metrics.json + dashboards/synthetic-playback.json) and a small alert-simulation harness (tests/alert_simulator.py) used by SRE to estimate expected alert noise per tenant.
- Adds unit + e2e tests and a Helm values change to gate rollout with a feature-flag.

Design notes and tradeoffs:
- Normalization semantics: the service emits two streams per metric: a rank_percentile (P0-100) using an approximate t-digest and a z_score computed against a rolling mean+std over a 6-hour window. For low-sample tenants (<200 invocations in window) we emit a sparse flag and fall back to global percentiles to avoid volatility.
- Storage: we keep sketches per tenant with aggressive TTL + compacting to bound memory. We chose t-digest for percentiles because it compresses heavy tails well and supports merge.
- Performance: normalizer runs as a horizontally scalable service with sharding by tenant hash; ingestion cost added ~2-3% CPU in benchmarks with 1k tenants per shard. The synth_playback is intentionally single-threaded for deterministic replay; a parallel mode exists behind a flag for load testing.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests for normalization math and sketch merges (tests/normalizer_test.py).
- Integration smoke: replayed 10k synthetic invocations representing three customer shapes; validated normalized dashboards match expected rank ordering and z-scores move consistently when we inject latency shifts.
- Alert sim: tests/alert_simulator.py runs replay and computes FPR/TPR estimates for current alert rules; included a short report that influenced an alert tuning change for token-cost-95 alert.

Rollout plan:
- Feature-flagged behind helm values.observability.enableMetricNormalizer = false by default.
- Canary rollout to 2 internal tenants for 48h, then opt-in for more tenants using route-level annotation.
- Monitoring: added internal dashboards and health checks; will watch sample_count_sparse rate and normalized series deviation.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] Integration replay tests
- [x] Dashboards added and linked in docs
- [x] Feature flag + Helm values
- [x] Load bench (small) and memory caps

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the low-sample fallback semantics, the memory TTL choices, and the API shape for consumers (tenant_norm_{metric} + tenant_norm_meta labels). The PR contains a migration note in docs/observability/metric-normalization.md describing backwards compatibility and consumer adoption steps.

release_notes: Adds a tenant-aware metric normalizer and a deterministic synthetic token playback tool to enable reproducible dashboard replays and alert simulations. Feature-flagged rollout and dashboards included. Impact: observability teams can compare normalized metrics across tenants and run deterministic alert noise simulations.
notes_for_qa: Use tools/replay/fixtures to run synth_playback against a staging ingest endpoint; enable helm value observability.enableMetricNormalizer=true for validation. Watch normalizer.sparse_fallback_rate and heap under load.
